Code § 1946.2(a)), so a lease that is exempt when signed becomes covered mid-tenancy. Check that `tpa-exemption-notice-ca` and every clause relying on an exemption self-limits to the period the exemption applies (Colorado's `month-to-month-notice-co-exempt` was rewritten this way for C.R.S. § 38-12-1302(1)(e)).
